## Summary Records-only PR. On 2026-10-25 the owner delegated Flight Recorder decisions O1–O8 to the recommended defaults. Under the `CLAUDE.md` rule that a decision must be logged before dependent code, these rows land before any Flight Recorder implementation PR (MVP waits for 0.4.0 and #869, #870, #873). ## Changes - New `docs/specs/SPEC-008-flight-recorder-and-evidence-bundle.md` stub with a `## Decisions log (added 2026-10-25)` table. Eight rows, one per default, each marked owner-delegated: - O1: keep "flight recorder" as description; CLI `ashlar flight`; defer trademark search; docs use "Ashlar Flight" for now. - O2: signed exports open; paid = compliance reports, Fleet aggregation, org retention, witness/TSA, key custody. - O3: one SPEC-008 covering flight recorder + `ashlar-evidence/v1` shared with release evidence. - O4: emit both `MCP_BRICK_INVOKED` and the flight run for one minor release, then flight-only. - O5: default MCP host capture level is `actions`. - O6: operator key in the MVP; separate-user/hardware key as phase-2. - O7: reasoning opt-in allowed under AirGapped and SecureWorkstation (local; label ceiling on export). - O8: evaluate Tracekit/C2SP interop after the MVP; do not block on it. - `docs/DocsIndex.md` gains an entry for the stub. - Knowledge graph regenerated after `git add` (no artifact delta for this docs-only stub). - Design §11 in the consumer-pilot store marked each decision owner-delegated (not in this PR). ## Testing - `python3 scripts/ctx.py decisions flight` / `O1` / `O8` find the new rows. - `scripts/knowledge-graph/verify-knowledge-graph-current.py` passes. - `scripts/ci/verify-doc-anchors.py` passes. - Docs only; no behavioural change to mutation-check. ## Merge note Please merge when CLEAN and green between audit-fix PRs so this does not starve the 0.4.0 / #869–#873 queue. No MVP implementation in this PR. ## Checklist - [x] Documentation updated - [x] Not a versioned release; release steps skipped
